additional_context: FHIR-3827 is the same ReferralRequest.status change family and was applied in the same Jira-tagged commit by adding accepted. Current ServiceRequest.status binds to the general RequestStatus value set rather than the old DSTU1 ReferralRequest-specific lifecycle.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The DSTU1 status renames were applied before ReferralRequest was retired, and adding the old ReferralRequest-specific codes to current ServiceRequest.status would be an unsupported current-version change.
